items.title: These 7 private and public banking stocks have an upside of up to 20% in one year, according to analyst
items.description: When FPI money returns, there are two parts of the market that tend to draw it first: Financial services broadly, and banks within it. So the very thing that worked against these stocks when the FPIs were selling has started to work for them now that the foreigners are buying. Monday saw the first clear sign of it.

items.title: Stocks in news: Cochin Shipyard, Kalyan Jewellers, MRF, Coal India, BHEL and Bajaj Finance
items.description: Indian markets are set to resume trading after the Diwali holiday, with investors tracking key stocks such as Cochin Shipyard, Kalyan Jewellers, MRF, Coal India, BHEL and Bajaj Finance amid Q2 earnings and corporate developments. Nifty faces immediate resistance at 25,150–25,200.

items.title: D-St set for a cautious opening as GIFT Nifty signals muted start
items.description: The Nifty index showcased mixed movements on Monday, opening on a high note before being swayed by profit booking. Experts predict a period of consolidation ahead for Indian stocks amid ongoing inflation apprehensions. Global market signals are expected to play a major role in shaping market trends, especially with promising earnings forecasts and lower crude oil costs.

items.title: Time to shed fear and think positive? 5 mid-cap stocks from different sectors with upside potential of up to 33%
items.description: Mid-cap stocks tend to move more than large-caps. And that works both ways. They rise faster when the market is rising, and fall harder when it is falling. Keep that in mind as the market’s mood changes for the better because oil prices are dropping and the macro worries responsible for the long sell-off are starting to go away.

items.title: Stock Radar: BSE stock up over 10% in a month, technical charts hint at a bottom?
items.description: BSE Ltd has recently broken out from an inverse head and shoulder pattern, indicating potential upward movement. The stock has previously experienced a correction but found support around Rs 3,000 levels. Experts predict a target above Rs 4,000 in the coming months if the stock sustains above crucial support levels. The daily MACD indicates bullish momentum, while the RSI shows it may still have room for growth.

items.title: Manyavar maker Vedant Fashions struggles to revive growth as same-store sales drop 5.8% in Q2
items.description: Manyavar maker Vedant Fashions is facing mounting competition and slowing growth, with same-store sales declining 5.8% in the September quarter. Revenue grew at an annual rate of just 2.7% between 2022-23 and 2025-26. Industry experts say demand moderation and aggressive store expansion have added to the company's challenges.

items.title: NCLT flags undervalued, fraudulent HDIL property sale in 2019
items.description: The order relates to a commercial office premises in Dheeraj Pali Arcade Building on Pali Road, Bandra West, which was transferred to the buyer through a registered sale agreement dated July 4, 2019. The transaction involved former HDIL directors Rakesh Kumar Wadhawan and Sarang Rakesh Wadhawan.

items.title: Blackstone to invest Rs 5,000 crore in IIFL Finance for 16% stake as company raises Rs 6,414 crore
items.description: IIFL Finance will raise Rs 6,414 crore through a capital infusion led by Blackstone, which will invest Rs 5,000 crore for an approximately 16% stake. Co-promoters Nirmal Jain and R Venkataraman will contribute Rs 1,264 crore through warrants, while Anchorage Capital will invest Rs 150 crore.

items.title: Zerodha users flag glitches in BSE F&O price update; broker says issue resolved
items.description: Zerodha experienced a technical setback on Wednesday, which hampered price updates within the futures and options sector of BSE. This situation concerned various brokers, leading to anxiety among derivatives traders who rely heavily on accurate real-time data. Zerodha quickly collaborated with the exchange to rectify the problem, successfully resolving it later in the day.

items.title: Centre's EV push puts electric mobility stocks in the fast lane; M&M, Ola Electric lead rally with gains of up to 5%
items.description: Electric mobility stocks rallied on Wednesday after the Centre made EVs the default choice for government staff-car procurement and doubled the price ceiling for electric cars to Rs 20 lakh. M&M led the gains, followed by Ola Electric, Hyundai Motor India and TVS Motor Company.

items.title: Positive Breakout: These 5 stocks rose above their 200 DMAs
items.description: In the Nifty 500 pack, six stocks gained over 2% and their closing prices crossed above their respective 200-day moving averages (DMAs) on November 9, 2026, according to StockEdge's technical scan data. The 200-day moving average (DMA) is used by traders as a key indicator for determining the overall trend of a stock. As long as a stock's price remains above its 200-day moving average on the daily timeframe, it is generally interpreted as being in an overall uptrend.

items.title: Ashoka Buildcon shares rally 14% after securing Rs 866 crore NHAI contract for Vadodara-Mumbai Expressway
items.description: Ashoka Buildcon's shares surged after securing a significant NHAI contract for the Vadodara-Mumbai Expressway. The company will complete the construction work on the Karvad-Jujuwa section with an 18-month execution timeline. The contract is valued at Rs 865.90 crore, excluding GST, with a 10-year defect liability period. Additionally, the firm's Q2 profit and total income both increased slightly compared to the previous year.

items.title: NSE shares rise 2%, recover 20% from record low in less than a month. Why Motilal Oswal sees 19% upside
items.description: NSE shares hit a record high of Rs 1,965, recovering 20% from their recent low. Motilal Oswal initiated coverage with a Buy rating and a target price of Rs 2,300, citing structural growth opportunities, market leadership and improving earnings prospects.

items.title: Bajaj Finance to launch share sale worth up to Rs 11,700 cr this week: Report
items.description: Bajaj Finance Ltd. is gearing up for a major share sale aimed at raising an impressive 117 billion rupees. The initiative seeks to draw in institutional investors, with the specifics of the offering currently being finalized. Following the completion of investor roadshows, a qualified institutions placement may take place soon.

items.title: Tata Steel shares rise 2%. Why brokerages remain bullish; see up to 30% upside potential
items.description: Tata Steel shares rise over 2% following strong Q2 FY27 earnings, with net profit increasing 16% year-on-year. Brokerages largely retain Buy ratings, although target prices vary. Nomura cuts its target, while Jefferies remains optimistic and Axis Securities upgrades its rating, citing improving margins and earnings prospects.

items.title: HEG Advanced Materials shares gain 5% after subsidiary secures Rs 610 crore incentive under ECMS
items.description: HEG Advanced Materials shares rise 5% after subsidiary TACC receives ₹609.50 crore incentive approval under the ECMS scheme for its Dewas synthetic graphite anode project, supporting domestic battery manufacturing, capacity expansion and India's advanced energy storage ecosystem. The first production phase targets commissioning by June 2027.

items.title: Promoters’ stake hits 3-year high while FIIs sink to 14-year low: What it means for Indian stocks
items.description: Indian promoters raised their ownership in listed companies to a three-year high as foreign institutional investors' shareholding fell to a 14-year low in September 2026. Promoters bought shares worth Rs 6,595 crore during the quarter, while domestic mutual funds reached a record ownership level, narrowing the gap with FIIs.

items.title: IIFL Finance shares rally 5% as Blackstone leads Rs 6,414 crore capital infusion
items.description: IIFL Finance shares surged on Wednesday after the company announced a Rs 6,414 crore capital infusion led by Blackstone, which will invest Rs 5,000 crore. The fundraise, also involving promoter investments and Anchorage Capital, aims to strengthen capital adequacy, lower funding costs and accelerate growth in secured lending.

items.title: Diwali dhamaka isn’t over! How a Rs 38 lakh crore bull run sent Sensex up 8,000 points and Nifty up 10% in 8 days
items.description: India’s Diwali rally has added nearly Rs 38 lakh crore to BSE-listed companies’ market value in just eight trading sessions, with the Sensex surging nearly 8,000 points and the Nifty gaining 10% to cross 25,400. The rally has been driven by aggressive FII buying of Rs 53,170 crore this month, stronger global sentiment as the AI trade cools, and robust Q2 earnings

items.title: MRF shares fall after heavy raw material costs push Q2 profit down. Why Motilal Oswal screams Sell
items.description: MRF reported a 27% YoY decline in Q2 consolidated net profit to Rs 387 crore, as a 43% surge in raw material costs offset 17% revenue growth to Rs 8,660 crore. Motilal Oswal maintained its ‘Sell’ rating with a target price of Rs 1.05 lakh, citing margin pressure, rising input costs and demand concerns.

items.title: HDFC Bank shares jump 22% from 52-week low in 10 days; analysts see private lender nearing an inflection point. Time to buy or wait?
items.description: HDFC Bank shares have surged 22% in 10 days as governance concerns ease and operational performance improves. Analysts see an earnings recovery ahead, with some recommending a buy while others suggest holding and accumulating on dips.

items.title: Kalyan Jewellers shares zoom 10%, hit upper circuit after strong Q2 earnings. What analysts are saying
items.description: Kalyan Jewellers shares surged 10% after the company reported a 64% year-on-year jump in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 427 crore, aided by a one-time gain. Revenue rose 31% to Rs 10,323 crore, while EBITDA increased nearly 30% to Rs 645 crore. The stock briefly hit its upper circuit on the NSE.

items.title: Cochin Shipyard shares tumble 8% as Q2 profit falls 50% YoY despite revenue growth
items.description: Cochin Shipyard shares fell sharply on Wednesday after the company reported a nearly 50% year-on-year decline in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 54 crore. Despite a 12% rise in revenue to Rs 1,249 crore, higher expenses weighed on profitability. The company also announced an interim dividend of Rs 3 per share.

items.title: Earnings recovery, FII revival: 5 factors that will shape Dalal Street's next move after Q2
items.description: Indian equities are recovering as stronger Q2 earnings, renewed FII inflows and attractive largecap valuations lift sentiment. Analysts identify five key triggers for Dalal Street’s next move, including global AI volatility, geopolitical risks and sectoral flows.
